patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Download the patch from the link below. Once you have downloaded the file, locate the steam directory for the game (right click on the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). To apply the patch, copy the 'game' folder (from within the adult folder in the patch archive) into the game install folder mentioned above, merging the folder and overwriting the file if prompted. It's working if: It says 'Uncensored Edition' (instead of 'Steam Edition') on the main menu of the game. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
